one_month_reasoning: The only scheduled company event in the window is Q3 2026 earnings on 2026-10-29 before the open (source 44). The bar is EPS ~$9.8-9.9 on ~$22.1-22.4B revenue (source 37), below Q2's $23.0B, and Lilly beat Q2 by about $1.8-2.3 ($8.38 vs ~$6.0-6.6 consensus; sources 2, 38). Chain data from the quarter point to another volume beat: ~700k Medicare Bridge starts with ~70% on Lilly drugs (sources 23, 24), Foundayo at ~47.5k weekly scripts in the week to Sep 11, +8% w/w (source 48, IQVIA via Guggenheim), and over 30% of new oral patients (source 22). Zepbound returns to CVS Caremark's standard formulary as co-preferred from 2026-10-01 (sources 39, 53), which helps Q4 volume but may bring cautious net-price commentary for 2027. Novo reports 2026-11-04, after the window. I no longer treat a CagriSema FDA decision as a window event: it was filed in Dec 2025 with no PDUFA date disclosed, and a standard review points to roughly mid-December (sources 51, 52). September was flat in closing terms ($1,156.73 to $1,157.08; source 54), so there is no oversold rebound to bank on; the 3% dip after the EloraTZP data is too small to trade. Median ~$1,158 (+0.7%, a small positive earnings-setup tilt), sigma ~10.5% (35%/3.5 plus a little for the earnings day), close to symmetric.

fair_value.method: P/E on the NTM EPS the market will price in October 2027: ~$51.6 (0.25 x 2027E $47.5 + 0.75 x 2028E $53) x 22x = $1,136, weight 70%. Cross-check: mean analyst target $1,329 less a 10% optimism haircut = $1,196, weight 30%. Blend ~$1,155, about 0.5% above the $1,149.85 close.

inputs_detail.derivation: MarketScreener shows $44.49 on the same $102.06B revenue (source 47), which looks stale; I use the newer $47.51.

Published 2028 consensus is $51.0-52.3 (sources 47, 49, 50), so my round-1 $55 (2027 x1.16) was above the Street without evidence. I sit ~$1 above the consensus midpoint because (a) MarketScreener's 2028 figure is built on a stale 2027 base ($44.49 vs $47.51 now; its own 2027-28 growth of +14.7% applied to $47.51 would give ~$54.5), (b) revisions are running up (19 up / 4 down; source 8), and (c) Guggenheim lifted Foundayo to $1.8B/2027 and $3.7B/2028 (source 48) and Medicare Bridge uptake (~700k, 70% Lilly; sources 23, 24) is ahead of plan. Against that, the Bridge ends 2027-12-31 with no successor, so I do not go to the $54.5 mechanical figure.

Today's price / 2027 consensus = 24.2x. I assume about 2 turns of compression by Oct 2027 as growth slows to ~11-12% in 2028 (source 47): by then the 2028 Medicare coverage cliff (Bridge ends 2027-12-31, BALANCE Part D indefinitely delayed; source 29), MariTide Phase 3 data (source 16) and Paragraph IV litigation (sources 31, 32; compound patent to 2036, so a terminal-multiple issue only) sit closer. 51.6 x 22 = $1,136.

bear.story: The price war spreads. Novo's $675 Wegovy list price from January 2027, PBM and CVS concessions, more employers dropping coverage (BGH: 10% of current coverers plan to drop in 2027) and the $245 Medicare price push US net price down 15-20% a year. Investors price the post-2027 Medicare cliff because BALANCE Part D is indefinitely delayed. Strong MariTide Phase 3 data in early 2027 or a CagriSema approval (likely ~Dec 2026) make the class look crowded; an adverse 7th Circuit ruling classifies retatrutide as an NDA (5 years of exclusivity rather than 12). 2027 EPS ~$44, NTM ~$46, multiple ~17x = ~$790.

base.story: Volume keeps outrunning price. Lilly holds about 60% of US obesity scripts and about 70% of new Medicare starts; Zepbound regains CVS volume from Oct 1; Foundayo keeps taking about a third of new oral starts and reaches the Guggenheim-style ~$1.8B in 2027. 2027 EPS ~$47-48, 2028E ~$53 (near consensus), NTM ~$51.6-52 at ~22x. The retatrutide BLA goes in in Q1 2027 with approval most likely in early 2028; EloraTZP enters Phase 3.

bull.story: Foundayo's new-patient share turns into total oral share, Medicare uptake compounds and CMS signals permanent Part D coverage, the 7th Circuit upholds BLA status, retatrutide gets a priority or national-priority voucher putting approval inside or just after the horizon, and MariTide data underwhelm. 2027 EPS beats to ~$50, 2028 moves toward ~$58 (the upper half of the $43-62 estimate range), NTM ~$57 x ~27x = ~$1,540, near Citi's $1,600.

thesis_break_reason: Near $830 (about -28%, ~17.5x 2027 consensus EPS of $47.5, below the lowest Street target of $930) the market would most likely be pricing a structural break rather than 35%-vol noise; LLY has had 23-34% drawdowns without broken fundamentals, so I would want this level together with 2027/2028 estimates being cut toward ~$43/$46. Candidate causes: US tirzepatide net price collapsing toward the $245-350/month Medicare and TrumpRx levels across commercial channels after the January 2027 resets; no Medicare successor to the Bridge after 2027-12-31; a lasting share loss to the Wegovy pill, CagriSema or MariTide; an adverse 7th Circuit ruling on retatrutide's classification or a safety setback; or an adverse early Paragraph IV ruling against the 2036 compound patent.

reasoning: Round 2 takes the supervisor's findings as corrections and adds 6 targeted searches/reads. (1) The material fix is 2028 EPS. I had $55 (2027 x1.16) with no evidence it beat consensus; published 2028 consensus is $51.0-52.3 (MarketScreener $51.01 on +11.6% revenue; Yahoo $51.34 from 8 analysts; 24/7 Wall St $52.29, range $43-62). I use $53, ~$1 above the midpoint, because MarketScreener's 2028 sits on a stale 2027 base ($44.49 vs $47.51), revisions run 19 up/4 down, and Guggenheim just raised Foundayo to $1.8B/$3.7B for 2027/2028 on IQVIA data I confirmed (47.5k weekly, +8% w/w, week to Sep 11). NTM at the horizon is ~$51.6, x22x = $1,136 (was $1,210). Blended with the haircut target ($1,196) at 70/30, fair value falls from $1,205 to ~$1,155. I keep 22x rather than the supervisor's 22.5-23.5x because by October 2027 the market will be looking at the 2028 Medicare cliff, a slowing growth rate and Paragraph IV litigation. (2) Facts dropped or changed: the 183k Wegovy-pill figure (a blocked-page snippet) is no longer used; the last confirmed IQVIA read is ~172k (August, via Citi). CagriSema is most likely a December event, not October. September was flat in closing terms ($1,156.73 to $1,157.08), consistent with my round-1 correction that the stock was not down 7%. (3) Facts confirmed: 700k Bridge starts and 70% on Lilly; Bridge to 2027-12-31 with BALANCE delayed; CVS co-preferred Zepbound from Oct 1; the 7th Circuit retatrutide classification appeal (argued Sep 24) is now an explicit bear/bull branch. Scenarios: bear $790 (22%), base $1,150 (53%), bull $1,540 (25%); mean ~$1,171. Distribution: roughly lognormal, median ~$1,160 (was ~$1,200), sigma ~0.33 with a slightly fat left tail for a price-war or coverage-cliff shock; P(>=spot) 0.52 (was 0.55); right tail trimmed slightly because 2028 growth of ~11-12% does not support much beyond Citi's $1,600. Research was limited to 6 queries in this round; consensus came from MarketScreener, StockAnalysis, Yahoo and 24/7 aggregates.
